_comment: Spec-derived goldens for tests/fixtures/inventory/exports/*.jsonl, read through FileExportContentSource and normalised with normalize_document. Assertions in a record take precedence over parsed HTML (SourceAssertions). links: [link_type, resolved_url or null, anchor_text, anchor_source, rel]. Changing an expectation is a reviewed decision.

https://export.fixture.test/reports/indi._covers: asserted title/state/language(case-folded)/dates/metadata/external_id/page_type; body_html is a FRAGMENT (no <body>): the whole fragment is the content root; allowed_hosts link is internal.
https://export.fixture.test/reports/indi.title: India EV Market Report (asserted)

https://export.fixture.test/reports/sea-._covers: draft state; asserted canonical (declared, in scope); nav removed from a full document.
https://export.fixture.test/reports/sea-.title: SEA EV Draft

https://export.fixture.test/insights/bat._covers: unpublished state; fragment with h1 title fallback; http:// link to an in-scope host is internal and keeps its scheme.
https://export.fixture.test/insights/bat.title: Battery Cost Outlook

https://export.fixture.test/fr/marche-ve._covers: no assertions at all: publication_state unknown (not public_web), language from <html lang>, title from <title> (non-ASCII, NFC).
https://export.fixture.test/fr/marche-ve.title: Marché des véhicules électriques

https://export.fixture.test/about._covers: asserted canonical equal to own URL -> self.
https://export.fixture.test/about.title: About the fixture publisher

https://export.fixture.test/reports/indi._covers: asserted canonical beats <link rel=canonical>; meta robots NOINDEX lower-cased; rel=alternate kept.
https://export.fixture.test/reports/indi.title: India EV (print)

v2_changed._comment: valid.jsonl -> v2_changed.jsonl. content_hash must change ONLY for content changes (ADR-0009 section 4).

why.https://export.fixture.test/reports/indi: body text changed ('growing fast' -> 'growing very fast')
why.https://export.fixture.test/reports/sea-: link target changed, anchor text identical (a content change for an interlinking system)
why.https://export.fixture.test/insights/bat: whitespace-only HTML formatting change (body text is whitespace-collapsed)
why.https://export.fixture.test/about: only page_type, modified_at and metadata changed: excluded from the hash

with_errors._comment: Per-record failures are SourceIssues, never exceptions; records keep file order.
why: line 6: ftp:// URL cannot be normalised
line 7: host not in the header's scope

bad_header._comment: version 2 is not a supported export version: the source as a whole cannot continue, so it RAISES (from site_scope or iter_records) instead of yielding issues.
